name: fetch_defect_data
description: Fetch all defect log rows from Meridian's production database for a given date. Returns raw defect records joined with line names.

date.description: ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) for the shift date to query

name: compute_statistics
description: Compute per-line defect statistics from raw defect rows. Returns mean, stddev, critical count, and 7-day rolling average for each production line.

defect_rows.description: Array of defect log rows returned by fetch_defect_data

name: detect_outliers
description: Flag production lines where today's defect count exceeds N standard deviations above the 7-day mean.

sigma_threshold.description: Number of standard deviations above mean to flag as outlier. Default: 3

name: generate_report
description: Generate the HTML email body for the QA defect report.

outlier_flags.description: Outlier flags from detect_outliers (may be empty)

name: send_email
description: Send the QA report email to the Meridian shift supervisor distribution list via Resend.

html_body.description: Full HTML email body from generate_report

recipients.description: Recipient email addresses. Must match approved list only.

name: log_run
description: Log the agent run result to eevolvv's agent_runs table in Supabase. Always call this, even on failure.

lines_reported.description: Number of production lines included in report

error.description: Error message if status is failure or partial

tokens_used.description: Total tokens consumed by this run
